Tshaha ya mina GPS UnifiedNlp Vukorhokeri bya Vundhawu
Mpfumelelo wa Signature Level, lowu lavekaka eka Mock my GPS ku nyika swiviko swa ndhawu eka swa yona UnifiedNlp Endzhaku.
Matirhiselo "Tshaha ya mina GPS" Tanihi muhakeri wa ndhawu ya le ndzhaku loko vukorhokeri bya yona byi tirha.

Ntsengo wa timilisekoni lowu engeteriwaka eka timestamp ya swiviko hinkwaswo swa ndhawu. Ntsengo lowu ringaneke wu fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku vaphakeri van\'wana hinkwavo va le ndzhaku a va tekeriwi enhlokweni loko ku endliwa vukanganyisi.:
